representative_locations.name: West Texas Solar Belt
representative_locations.rationale: Top US solar resource area with 5.58 kWh/m²/day G-pHI, 45 GW installed capacity, excellent grid access via ERCOT
representative_locations.selection_criteria: Represents best-in-class US solar resource with mature market infrastructure

representative_locations.name: Iowa Midwest Wind Corridor
representative_locations.rationale: Best US wind resource with 40-45% capacity factors, 12 GW state capacity, strong grid infrastructure
representative_locations.selection_criteria: Represents premier US wind region with consistent high-quality resource

key_strengths: IRA provides 30% ITC + 10% bonuses through 2032
Corporate PPA market very active (Amazon 10 GW, Google 8 GW targets)
Large domestic market with high electricity demand
Mature supply chain and project development ecosystem
key_challenges: Grid interconnection delays 3-5 years (MISO/SPP)
Policy uncertainty post-2032 (ITC phase-down)
Land acquisition competitive in prime areas
Labor costs increased 30% (2022-2024)

representative_locations.name: Gujarat Solar Park Zone
representative_locations.rationale: Best grid connectivity in India, 25 GW state capacity, dedicated 30 GW renewable zone with plug-and-play infrastructure
representative_locations.selection_criteria: Represents India's most developed solar market with lowest execution risk

representative_locations.name: Tamil Nadu Wind Corridor
representative_locations.rationale: Mature wind market with 18 GW state capacity, excellent wind resource, established supply chain ecosystem
representative_locations.selection_criteria: Represents India's premier wind region with proven track record

key_strengths: PLI scheme offers 20% capital subsidy for domestic manufacturing
Large and growing domestic market (500 GW target by 2030)
SECI auctions provide transparent price discovery
Accelerated depreciation (40%) reduces tax burden
key_challenges: DISCOM payment delays 6-12 months (improving in Gujarat/Karnataka)
Grid curtailment issues in high renewable states (Rajasthan 8%)
Land acquisition challenges in some states
Permitting complexity (environment clearances 12-18 months)

representative_locations.name: Bavaria Solar Region
representative_locations.rationale: Southern Germany strong solar resource, high rooftop penetration, good feed-in tariff support
representative_locations.selection_criteria: Represents Germany's solar heartland with mature residential and commercial markets

representative_locations.name: North Sea Offshore Wind Zone
representative_locations.rationale: World-class wind resource with 45-55% capacity factors, 40 GW planned North Sea expansion, zero-subsidy bids common
representative_locations.selection_criteria: Represents Germany's premier wind region with globally competitive economics

key_strengths: EEG 2023 provides stable 20-year feed-in tariffs
Offshore wind CfD model ensures revenue certainty
Highest renewable penetration globally (56% of generation in 2024)
Very strong grid infrastructure and market integration
key_challenges: Grid constraints (north-south transmission bottleneck)
Wind curtailment increasing (6.2 TWh in 2024, €1.1B compensation)
Onshore wind permitting slow despite reforms
High industrial electricity prices (€150-200/MWh)

representative_locations.name: Northeast Brazil Solar Region
representative_locations.rationale: Excellent solar resource near equator, rapidly growing solar market
representative_locations.selection_criteria: Represents Brazil's emerging solar opportunity with world-class resource

representative_locations.name: Northeast Brazil Wind Corridor
representative_locations.rationale: Exceptional wind resource with 40-50% capacity factors, established wind market
representative_locations.selection_criteria: Represents Brazil's proven wind leadership in Latin America

key_strengths: Exceptional wind and solar resources (world-class capacity factors)
Large domestic market with growing electricity demand
Competitive auction system (contratos de diferenças)
Strong local content and manufacturing incentives
key_challenges: Policy uncertainty with government changes
Grid infrastructure needs expansion in remote areas
Financing costs higher than developed markets
Currency risk for international investors

representative_locations.name: Queensland Solar Region
representative_locations.rationale: Outstanding solar resource (6+ kWh/m²/day), strong grid in populated areas
representative_locations.selection_criteria: Represents Australia's exceptional solar opportunity with grid access

representative_locations.name: South Australia Wind Zone
representative_locations.rationale: Excellent wind resource, high renewable penetration state (60%+ renewable)
representative_locations.selection_criteria: Represents Australia's wind leadership and grid integration success

key_strengths: World-class solar and wind resources (highest global capacity factors)
Advanced grid integration experience (SA 60%+ renewable)
Strong renewable energy targets (82% by 2030)
Developed financial markets and stable legal system
key_challenges: Policy uncertainty with government transitions
Grid connection challenges in remote areas
Market volatility in National Electricity Market (NEM)
Limited export opportunities (island nation)
